connector.name: Iranti
connector.registryDescription: Persistent, shared memory for AI agents - facts, checkpoints, semantic search.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package iranti. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nfemmanuel account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the Iranti database.

env.name: IRANTI_API_KEY
env.description: API key for a remote Iranti instance (e.g. iranti.cloud).

env.name: IRANTI_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Iranti API server (e.g. https://<slug>.iranti.cloud).
